verdict.line: You lose if you eat Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) poke for free before level 3; you win once you land E into Q and start stacking your passive in his face.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's 50.8% win rate over 1,558 games with a lane and solo-kill edge comes from out-trading Ornn once E (Death's Grasp) closes the gap his longer Q (Volcanic Rupture, range 800) tries to hold. Ornn's passive Living Forge gives him bonus armor/MR and lets him buy forged items without recalling, so he won't get starved off waves the way most melee matchups punish — your edge has to come from trade windows, not attrition.

theirWindow.when: Ornn's Q lands and slows you
theirWindow.what: The magma pillar forms a beat after the fissure hits; if you're slowed near it expect Ornn to follow with E (Searing Charge) into the terrain for a knockup. Walk off the pillar's line immediately rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.what: Death's Grasp pulls him into melee range at 700 range, inside his own Q comfort zone. Land it, follow with Q (Obliterate, bonus damage on a single target) and weave an auto to trigger your passive's damage aura mid-trade.

powerCurve.note: his Q outranges your kit before you have E
E-Q all-ins land once E unlocks
R isolates him, strips his forged stats
his masterwork items close the gap

start.why: Picked in 79.6% of games for a reason: the mana sustain and AP let you spam Q/E in extended trades against a champion who out-ranges your first two levels.

boots.why: 51.8% pick rate; the tenacity shortens the slow from Q (Volcanic Rupture) and the knockup window from a terrain-collision E (Searing Charge) or his R elemental.

core.why: The slow on Q/E makes your pulls and follow-ups stick instead of letting Ornn walk out of Obliterate's single-target bonus damage.
Damage amp plus the omnivamp keeps you ahead in the healing race against Ornn's own sustain and lane poke.
Burn damage punishes a tanky brawler who stacks resistances through Living Forge; this is the 14.8% pick-rate path with the best measured win rate.

situational.when: you're trading sustained damage into his poke and need the extra healing amp
his team adds a heavy-AD duelist or healer you need to shut down
you want more flat magic damage and don't need Liandry's burn specifically

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the exact prolonged trades this matchup rewards — E-Q-auto strings into Ornn build adaptive force and heal, which matters since he has no hard sustained-damage answer once you're in melee.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 70.3% of games and converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once E lands; Flash+Teleport (22.4% pick) is the alternative if you're prioritizing wave control and scaling over lane aggression.

playing.title: Track your passive stack counter
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on champions or monsters. Weave an auto into every Q/E rotation so the damage aura and move speed are live before you commit to the trade.

playing.title: Pull before you all-in
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (E) drags Ornn into melee range where Q (Obliterate)'s single-target bonus damage hits hardest. Don't throw E as poke — save it to start the trade.

playing.title: Hold your shield for his burst
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) stores damage taken as a shield you can later consume to heal. Pop it right as his Q/E combo lands, not preemptively, so you bank the most damage before converting.

playing.title: Respect terrain near his E
playing.detail: Searing Charge knocks up and damages in an area if Ornn collides with terrain while charging. Don't stand between him and a wall during his dash.

playing.title: Don't feed his passive stacking either
playing.detail: OP.GG flags that Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) can interrupt your own Darkness Rise stacking if you walk into the final gout of flame mid-combo. Land your stacking autos before he channels W, not during it.

playing.title: Shove waves when your passive is up
playing.detail: Living Forge lets Ornn buy forged items without recalling, so starving him off CS doesn't hit him the normal way. Push waves hard when you have an active trade advantage instead of trying to freeze him out.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (81,018 Mordekaiser games, 1,558 in this exact head-to-head). The trade timing and mechanical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Although Ornn is an easy opponent to lane against, his (W) can block your [P]. Do not let this happen.
